title: GPT-4 can pass the Korean National Licensing Examination for Korean Medicine Doctors

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's accuracy on the Korean National Licensing Examination for Korean Medicine Doctors (K-NLEKMD) and comparing its performance on culturally localized subjects (Traditional Korean Medicine-specialized knowledge and Korean medical law) versus general medical knowledge.

Evaluating the impact of prompt engineering techniques, specifically translating Korean questions and Chinese-character medical terms into English, to demonstrate performance differences stemming from the underrepresentation of Korean text in the model's training data.
